top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver would step out of the room to go to the kitchen and leave infants unsupervised.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Not Over Concrete or Asphalt (26 TAC §746.4907(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Play equipment was observed on the outdoor play area with rubber pieces for loose fill material that is installed over concrete.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three of five children's records reviewed did not have signed authorization to obtain emergency medical care.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications for Substitute Caregiver  -pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1209(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection it was found that the substitute caregiver was not current on their CPR and First Aid training.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §747.3213(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not wash a child's hands after changing there diaper.     This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver went to wash the child's hands.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.
